faq.q: Why do Bangladesh government forms require 300×300 pixels?
faq.a: The Bangladesh Public Service Commission (BPSC) and Teletalk recruitment engines standardize admit cards and verification databases on a square 300×300 aspect ratio under 100 KB.

faq.q: Will this tool keep my file size under 100 KB?
faq.a: Yes. Our binary compression algorithm precisely caps output file size between 60 KB and 99 KB, ensuring 100% server acceptance.

faq.q: Is my photo uploaded to any server?
faq.a: No. All cropping, facial alignment, and image encoding execute entirely client-side inside your browser.

faq.q: Can I use this on an Android or iPhone device?
faq.a: Yes. The tool runs directly in mobile Chrome, Safari, and Firefox without requiring any app installations.
